title: Apple Will Spend $1 Billion On New Texas Campus
text:
Apple Will Spend $1 Billion On New Texas Campus Video Credit: Wochit Business - Duration: 00:54s - Published 4 hours ago < > Embed Apple Will Spend $1 Billion On New Texas Campus
The Apple logo is shown during an Apple launch event in the Brooklyn borough of New York, U.S., October 30, 2018.
REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton (Reuters) - Apple Inc (AAPL.O) is investing $1 billion to build a new campus in North Austin, Texas and will spend another $10 billion for new data centers as part of a five-year investment aimed at creating 20,000 jobs in the United States.
